svg.text: Deployed architecture • Smart campus operations • 08 October 2026
Managed services are outside the VPC
Host: CloudWatch agent • nightly events backup
No running replica; available for manual recovery
Provisioned capacity • events TTL 30 days • PITR
Parameter Store: encrypted JWT signing key
Nightly events JSON backup • private bucket
IAM instance role / scoped application policy

Includes other labs; CampusPulse has no NAT gateway
Single-host prototype: no load balancer, Auto Scaling or automatic AZ failover. AWS APIs use TLS and IAM.
